notes: 61-unit LIHTC family community, built 2010, Hazelwood (East Portland). 60 of 61 units income-restricted; 18 units carry Home Forward project-based vouchers; 13 HUD-subsidized wheelchair-accessible units.

Asking price $3,936,580 = assumed Portland Housing Bureau loan (~$1.98M at 0%) + assumed NOAH loan (~$1.25M at 2.75%) + ~$700K cash to close, per the listing brokers' public post. Not verified against the OM (LoopNet CDN blocked this session).

No T-12 or rent roll available. Rents, vacancy and opex are analyst estimates from public rent listings, 2026 Portland MSA MTSP limits (4-person MFI $128,300), Hazelwood market rents, and OHCS FY24 portfolio expense data ($8,198/unit statewide, Portland Metro higher).

Debt is modeled as the assumed balances: LTC = $3.23M / all-in; blended rate 1.064% (PHB 0% + NOAH 2.75%), 30-yr amortization. This treats the PHB loan as amortizing, which is the conservative case; if it is deferred/residual-receipts, annual debt service falls by ~$66K.

ARV = restricted-asset value: scenario NOI capitalized at a 7.5% restricted cap (mission-buyer market). Market-rate value (~$200K/unit) is irrelevant because the extended use agreement likely runs to ~2070.
Rehab budget = $400K near-term capital needs placeholder for a 16-year-old wood-frame building (exterior paint/envelope, water heaters, HVAC, flooring). Replace with PCNA figure.

scenarios.label: Base — assumed subsidized debt
scenarios.description: Blended collected rent $1,400/unit (restricted + PBV units), 8% vacancy & bad debt, opex $9,800/unit incl. $400 reserves.

scenarios.label: Downside — OHCS portfolio-average performance
scenarios.description: Collected rent $1,150/unit, 10% economic loss, opex $10,500/unit. Approximates OHCS FY24 statewide averages.

scenarios.label: Upside — PBV rents at payment standard
scenarios.description: Collected rent $1,550/unit with 18 PBV units at Home Forward reasonable rent, 6% loss, opex $9,200/unit.

scenarios.label: Base — for-profit buyer loses property tax exemption
scenarios.description: Base case plus ~$100K/yr property tax if the ORS 307.540 nonprofit exemption is lost on transfer.

scenarios.label: Counterfactual — conventional debt, no assumption
scenarios.description: Base operations financed with a 65% LTC agency loan at 6.625% instead of assuming the PHB/NOAH debt.
